accountServiceHint: Works with services that speak Anthropic's API, such as GLM, Kimi and DeepSeek. Before saving, Cheese sends the model one minimal message to test it. The key is stored encrypted on Cheese and only its last four characters are shown. Your Claude Code runs on Cheese with it, and usage is billed to that service's account
actionFailed: That didn't work. Try again later
addService: Use a custom model service on a device
apiKeyHint: Before saving, Cheese asks Anthropic for its model list with this key, which costs nothing. The key is stored encrypted on Cheese and only its last four characters are shown. Your Claude Code runs on Cheese with it, and usage is billed to this key
keptOnAccount: Kept encrypted on your account; runs on Cheese
lede: The model accounts and services your Claude Code uses: those signed in on your devices, and the API keys and model services kept on your account. Keys are never shown here
name: Name (optional)
nameHint: Claude Code added to a project with this connection carries it in its name
offlineHint: The device is offline. Check again once it is online
removeBody: Claude Code on {device} will log out, and your Claude Code can no longer use it in projects. If the device is offline, it logs out when it comes back online. Claude Code you use yourself on that device is not affected
removeHeldBody: The key is deleted from Cheese right away, and Claude Code added to projects with it stops taking work
removedPending: No longer used. It logs out when the device comes online
revokingHint: No longer used. It logs out when {device} comes online
serviceHint: Works with services that speak Anthropic's API, such as GLM, Kimi and DeepSeek. The key is sent straight to the device and kept only there. Once saved, Claude Code on that device uses this service
